Elements.Title: Warning
Elements.Content:
If you get an error message saying 'Error, Try again',
don't worry, it will be taken again.
Sometimes removed from Brainrot

Elements.Script: local Players = game:GetService('Players'); local lp = Players.LocalPlayer; getgenv().EscapeSelectedRarities = {All = true}; getgenv().EscapeSelectedBrainrots = {All = true}; getgenv().EscapeAutoTakeEnabled = false; local rarityDropdown; local brainrotDropdown; local indexDataCache = {}; local rarityValid = {All = true}; local brainrotValid = {All = true}; local PRIORITY_Y = -50; local PRIORITY_Y_TOLERANCE = 10; local function normalizeSelection(raw, valid) local out = {}; local hasSpecific = false; local function addValue(v) if type(v) ~= 'string' then return end; if valid and not valid[v] then return end; out[v] = true; if v ~= 'All' then hasSpecific = true end end; if type(raw) == 'string' then addValue(raw) elseif type(raw) == 'table' then for _, v in pairs(raw) do if type(v) == 'string' then addValue(v) end end; for k, v in pairs(raw) do if type(k) == 'string' and v then addValue(k) end end end; if not hasSpecific then out.All = true end; if hasSpecific then out.All = nil end; if next(out) == nil then out.All = true end; return out end; local function getIndexScrollingFrame() local pg = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui'); local mainUI = pg and pg:FindFirstChild('MainUI'); local indexFrame = mainUI and mainUI:FindFirstChild('IndexFrame'); return indexFrame and indexFrame:FindFirstChild('ScrollingFrame') end; local function buildIndexData() local map = {}; local scroll = getIndexScrollingFrame(); if not scroll then return map end; for _, child in ipairs(scroll:GetChildren()) do if child:IsA('Frame') then local name = tostring(child.Name); if name ~= '' and not map[name] then local brainrot = child:FindFirstChild('Brainrot'); local rarityLabel = brainrot and brainrot:FindFirstChild('RarityLabel'); local rarityText = (rarityLabel and rarityLabel:IsA('TextLabel') and tostring(rarityLabel.Text)) or ''; map[name] = {rarity = rarityText} end end end; return map end; local function buildRarityValues(indexData) local values = {'All'}; local valid = {All = true}; for _, info in pairs(indexData) do local rarity = tostring(info.rarity or ''); if rarity ~= '' and not valid[rarity] then valid[rarity] = true; table.insert(values, rarity) end end; table.sort(values, function(a, b) if a == 'All' then return true end; if b == 'All' then return false end; return a < b end); return values, valid end; local function buildBrainrotValues(indexData, selectedRarities) local values = {'All'}; local valid = {All = true}; for name, info in pairs(indexData) do local include = false; if selectedRarities and selectedRarities.All then include = true else local rarity = tostring(info.rarity or ''); if selectedRarities and selectedRarities[rarity] then include = true end end; if include and not valid[name] then valid[name] = true; table.insert(values, name) end end; table.sort(values, function(a, b) if a == 'All' then return true end; if b == 'All' then return false end; return a < b end); return values, valid end; local function refreshDropdownData() indexDataCache = buildIndexData(); local rarityValues; rarityValues, rarityValid = buildRarityValues(indexDataCache); local brainrotValues; brainrotValues, brainrotValid = buildBrainrotValues(indexDataCache, getgenv().EscapeSelectedRarities or {All = true}); return rarityValues, brainrotValues end; local rarityValues, brainrotValues = refreshDropdownData(); rarityDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('EscapeRaritySelector', {Title = 'Select Rarity', Values = rarityValues, Default = {'All'}, Multi = true, Callback = function(V) getgenv().EscapeSelectedRarities = normalizeSelection(V, rarityValid); indexDataCache = buildIndexData(); local newValues; newValues, brainrotValid = buildBrainrotValues(indexDataCache, getgenv().EscapeSelectedRarities); getgenv().EscapeSelectedBrainrots = {All = true}; if brainrotDropdown then pcall(function() if brainrotDropdown.SetValues then brainrotDropdown:SetValues(newValues) elseif brainrotDropdown.Refresh then brainrotDropdown:Refresh(newValues) end end) end end}); brainrotDropdown = Value:AddDropdown('EscapeBrainrotSelector', {Title = 'Select Brainrots', Values = brainrotValues, Default = {'All'}, Multi = true, Callback = function(V) getgenv().EscapeSelectedBrainrots = normalizeSelection(V, brainrotValid) end}); local function buildAllowedNames() indexDataCache = buildIndexData(); local selectedR = getgenv().EscapeSelectedRarities or {All = true}; local selectedB = getgenv().EscapeSelectedBrainrots or {All = true}; local allR = selectedR.All == true; local allB = selectedB.All == true; if allR and allB then return nil end; local namesByRarity = {}; for name, info in pairs(indexDataCache) do if allR or selectedR[tostring(info.rarity or '')] then namesByRarity[name] = true end end; if allB then return namesByRarity end; local filtered = {}; for name in pairs(namesByRarity) do if selectedB[name] then filtered[name] = true end end; return filtered end; local function isDropFrameVisible() local pg = lp:FindFirstChild('PlayerGui'); local mainUI = pg and pg:FindFirstChild('MainUI'); local dropFrame = mainUI and mainUI:FindFirstChild('DropFrame'); return dropFrame and dropFrame:IsA('GuiObject') and dropFrame.Visible == true end; local function getConvertToolCFrame() local world = workspace:FindFirstChild('World'); local convertTool = world and world:FindFirstChild('ConvertTool'); if not convertTool then return nil end; if convertTool:IsA('BasePart') then return convertTool.CFrame end; if convertTool:IsA('Model') then return convertTool:GetPivot() end; local part = convertTool:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true); return part and part.CFrame or nil end; local function getRoot() local character = lp.Character; return character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') end; local function getNpcPromptData(npc) if not npc then return nil, nil end; local hrp = npc:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart', true); local prompt = hrp and hrp:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt', true); if hrp and prompt then return hrp, prompt end; local fallbackPrompt = npc:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ProximityPrompt', true); local fallbackPart = fallbackPrompt and fallbackPrompt.Parent; if fallbackPrompt and fallbackPart and fallbackPart:IsA('BasePart') then return fallbackPart, fallbackPrompt end; return nil, nil end; local function getNpcYDistanceFromPriority(npc) if not npc then return math.huge end; local hrp = npc:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart', true); if hrp and hrp:IsA('BasePart') then return math.abs(hrp.Position.Y - PRIORITY_Y) end; return math.huge end; local function pickNpcTarget(currentTarget, allowedNames) local spawned = workspace:FindFirstChild('NPCSpawned'); if not spawned then return nil end; local function isAllowed(npc) return (not allowedNames) or allowedNames[npc.Name] end; local priorityTarget = nil; local priorityDist = math.huge; for _, npc in ipairs(spawned:GetChildren()) do if isAllowed(npc) then local yDist = getNpcYDistanceFromPriority(npc); if yDist <= PRIORITY_Y_TOLERANCE and yDist < priorityDist then priorityDist = yDist; priorityTarget = npc end end end; if priorityTarget then return priorityTarget end; if currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent and isAllowed(currentTarget) then return currentTarget end; for _, npc in ipairs(spawned:GetChildren()) do if isAllowed(npc) then return npc end end; return nil end; Value:AddToggle('EscapeAutoTakeToggle', {Title = 'Auto Take', Default = false, Callback = function(V) getgenv().EscapeAutoTakeEnabled = V; if V then task.spawn(function() local currentTarget = nil; while getgenv().EscapeAutoTakeEnabled do local ok = pcall(function() local root = getRoot(); if not root then task.wait(0.05); return end; if isDropFrameVisible() then local convertCf = getConvertToolCFrame(); if convertCf then root.CFrame = convertCf end; while getgenv().EscapeAutoTakeEnabled and isDropFrameVisible() do root = getRoot(); if not root then break end; convertCf = getConvertToolCFrame(); if convertCf then root.CFrame = convertCf end; task.wait(0.05) end; currentTarget = nil; task.wait(0.02); return end; local allowedNames = buildAllowedNames(); currentTarget = pickNpcTarget(currentTarget, allowedNames); if currentTarget and currentTarget.Parent then local part, prompt = getNpcPromptData(currentTarget); if not part or not prompt then currentTarget = nil; task.wait(0.05); return end; root.CFrame = part.CFrame; fireproximityprompt(prompt) else currentTarget = nil; task.wait(0.08) end; task.wait(0.03) end); if not ok then task.wait(0.25) end end end) end end})
